name: maintain-server-containers
description: Portable policy-driven Docker Compose maintenance, safe read-only audits, and targeted deployment workflows for approved project-owned releases.

interface.shortDescription: Audit Docker and guide safe project/repository deployments
defaultPrompt: Audit my Compose server without changing its state.
Plan available container updates and tell me which are safe.
Update eligible AUTO_SAFE services under the current project's maintenance policy while preserving data.

Deploy the latest approved release of my project-managed application, verify persistent state and, if optional project-memory tooling is available and authorized, checkpoint confirmed deployment facts; otherwise report pending sync.
interface.longDescription: Audit and plan container maintenance; guide bounded agent-run deployment of approved project builds or external repositories. Core operations do not require other Agent Skills; optional memory/documentation synchronization may remain pending.
